comparisons.reason: Tests high-gain human-interface manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Refit and latch a vehicle headrest at its lowest position; unlike separating mixed loose bodies.
comparisons.physical_skill: Dual-post alignment, insertion, latch engagement, and release, not agitation through apertures.
comparisons.success_condition: Headrest must be fully inserted, locked at the lowest setting, released, and undamaged; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests keyed multi-post insertion and latching.

comparisons.objective: Collapse an empty produce crate flat for return; unlike sieve separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Release catches and fold articulated walls without forcing them, not bimanual screening.
comparisons.success_condition: All walls must finish flat with catches unforced and arms returned; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests articulated disassembly/folding.

comparisons.objective: Rotate a countertop display and restock two empty rear pockets; unlike material screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: Turn a carousel, locate pockets, and perform two box insertions, not load-sharing agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Both boxes must be seated in the formerly empty pockets without tipping the display; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests carousel access and indexed restocking.

comparisons.objective: Remove a drill bit from a keyless chuck and place it in a tray; unlike separating media from washers.
comparisons.physical_skill: Chuck loosening, axial extraction, and small-part placement, not bimanual sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Bit must clear the chuck, rest in the tray, drill remain supported, hands clear, and objects still; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests tool release and axial extraction.

comparisons.objective: Move a hot iron and leave it safely upright at the mat's right end; unlike screen separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard-aware grasping and heel-standing placement, not agitation of a loaded screen.
comparisons.success_condition: Iron must be stable on its heel in the target region without tipping, falling, or prolonged face-down placement; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests thermal-tool orientation safety.

comparisons.objective: Place a nickel strip on four cells and spot-weld every terminal; unlike mechanical screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sheet alignment followed by repeated probe placement and tool return, not selective particle passage.
comparisons.success_condition: Strip alignment, four weld contacts, welder return, arm withdrawal, and stable pack are required; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests multi-site joining and electrode alignment.

comparisons.objective: Remove an obstruction and insert a knife into a holder; unlike sifting mixed bodies.
comparisons.physical_skill: Obstacle removal plus narrow, slow blade insertion and safe release, not bimanual screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Knife must achieve specified depth/alignment and release; full credit also requires safely parking the toy obstruction; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained sharp-tool insertion.

comparisons.objective: Lay and release a figure-eight rope around two posts; unlike rigid-body screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable routing, crossing, and wrapping, not rigid screen load control.
comparisons.success_condition: Rope topology must form the required low figure-eight with hands clear; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable topology and routing.

comparisons.objective: Insert a battery in the correct polarity and screw on a flashlight cap; unlike sieve separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Polarity-aware insertion, thread engagement, and tightening while bracing the body.
comparisons.success_condition: Battery must be positive-end first, cap threaded and tightened, flashlight functional/assembled, and parts retained; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests keyed insertion and threaded fastening.

comparisons.objective: File a steel block flat to a scribed line; unlike separating loose parts.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual force-balanced reciprocating material removal and flatness control, not agitation for aperture passage.
comparisons.success_condition: Surface must meet height/flatness tolerances without crossing the spoil line, with file returned; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests controlled subtractive finishing.

comparisons.objective: Lock pliers onto a tube at a marked height and leave them self-supporting; unlike screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: One-gripper over-centre actuation and force-controlled clamping, not bimanual tilting.
comparisons.success_condition: Pliers must latch on the marked band, remain level and unsupported after release; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests over-centre latch engagement verified only after release.

comparisons.objective: Fit a booster-seat tray at its middle notch; unlike selective separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual rail alignment and simultaneous catch engagement, not loose-body agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Tray must lock at the second notch without moving/tipping the booster or dropping parts; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests paired sliding insertion and latching.

comparisons.objective: Replace a cabin air filter behind a glove box; unlike screen separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deflect glove-box walls past stops, extract/insert a filter, and restore the assembly without breakage.
comparisons.success_condition: New filter must be correctly installed after safe glove-box opening, old filter removed, and components restored; no material rubric detail is missing across versions.
comparisons.reason: Tests access-panel manipulation and constrained filter replacement.

comparisons.objective: Spin lettuce in a hand-crank spinner; shares agitation context but not selective recovery through a manipulated screen.
comparisons.physical_skill: Brace a bowl while continuously cranking to a turn/speed target; candidate instead grasps two tabs, lifts, tilts, sifts, reseats, and releases.
comparisons.success_condition: Requires crank turns or sustained basket speed with lid/bowl stable and crank released; no material rubric detail is missing across versions.
comparisons.reason: Rotary actuation of a contained basket does not test size-selective passage with simultaneous washer retention.

comparisons.objective: Extend a suitcase handle through the first stop and lock both rails at full height; unlike sifting.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sustained button actuation during telescoping extension followed by bilateral pin engagement.
comparisons.success_condition: Both rails must reach full height, both pins lock, button release, case remain placed, and hands clear; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests coupled telescoping mechanism control.

comparisons.objective: Press a door shut against a weatherstrip while turning its deadbolt; unlike screen separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual preload and rotary lock actuation, not load-sharing agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Door gap and bolt extension must meet locked tolerances and remain stable; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests force-assisted latch alignment.

comparisons.objective: Present a calibration board to a camera in a sufficient set of clear views, then rack it; unlike sifting.
comparisons.physical_skill: Large-board pose sampling, visibility/occlusion control, and return placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Requires the specified diversity of valid camera views with unobstructed board coverage and final rack return; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests active calibration target presentation.

comparisons.objective: Write a specified use-by date on a container label; unlike physical separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Marker grasp, contact-force control, and legible stroke generation on a bounded label.
comparisons.success_condition: Date characters must be legible and complete, mostly remain on the label, and container movement/tipping is penalized; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests tool-mediated writing.

comparisons.objective: Move a lamp closer before placing its plug in a tray; unlike screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: Manage lamp, cord, and plug reach without dragging or tipping the lamp.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug must finish in the tray while the lamp remains upright, on-table, and not improperly slid; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests tethered-object reach management.

comparisons.objective: Prove a voltage detector on a tester before and after checking a metal bar; unlike material separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequenced button operation, probe contact, indication monitoring, and conditional hazard avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: Valid tester indications must bracket the bar test, with no premature approach to the bar; no material rubric detail is missing across versions.
comparisons.reason: Tests safety-critical test-before-touch procedure.

comparisons.objective: Turn and place a long parcel into a tight bay without disturbing adjacent boxes; unlike screening.
comparisons.physical_skill: Collision-aware in-plane reorientation and precise placement of an elongated load.
comparisons.success_condition: Parcel must be flat, lengthwise, against the stop, released and still; moving either neighboring box invalidates the trial. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests confined parcel reorientation.

comparisons.objective: Pull open a stiff window using its delicate handle; unlike sieve separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Force-limited handle grasp and linear pulling without auxiliary contact or handle damage.
comparisons.success_condition: Credit follows counted handle-only opening distance; torn handle or damaged glass/frame forces zero. No material rubric detail is missing across all seven versions.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained linear actuation under a fragility limit.

comparisons.objective: Fit a blanking panel at a specified server-rack unit; unlike screening loose media.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual long-panel alignment, two-ended clip insertion, seating, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Panel edges must align to U6, both ends be home, and robot release persist for 1 second; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests precise wide-part rack insertion.

comparisons.objective: Erect and latch a folded crate for filling; unlike selective screen separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Unfold articulated walls and engage four corner catches, not tilt/agitate a loose-body load.
comparisons.success_condition: All four walls must be upright, all corners latched, crate retained, and hands released for the dwell; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests articulated assembly and multi-corner latching.

comparisons.objective: Remove capped needles from three Luer-lock syringes and discard them safely; unlike selective screen separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual barrel stabilization, cap rotation, axial withdrawal, and sharps placement—not load-sharing and orientation-dependent sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Needles unscrewed, still capped, released in sharps container; exposed needle is a whole-trial failure. Numeric thresholds are specified.
comparisons.reason: Tests safe threaded disassembly of attached parts, not selective passage of loose bodies through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Mark a banknote, classify it by mark color, and slide it to the corresponding mat; unrelated to media/workpiece separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pinning a light sheet while drawing, tool return, and planar sliding—not lifting and agitating a loaded screen.
comparisons.success_condition: A pinned ≥10 mm stroke, pen returned, correctly classified note released for 1 s, with explicit smear and damage failures.
comparisons.reason: The shared use of two hands and final release is generic; the tested abilities are marking and conditional routing.

comparisons.objective: Seat a 2.5-inch SSD in a tool-less drive carrier; not separate mixed loose bodies.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hold a sprung rail open while aligning four pins with drive holes and seating a rigid plate.
comparisons.success_condition: All pins engaged, rail closed, drive correctly oriented and flat, stable for 1 s. Earlier and later versions differ on whether prior misorientation invalidates success.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained insertion into spring-loaded locating pins, not size-selective sifting.

comparisons.objective: Elicit a knee reflex with a correctly placed brisk hammer tap, then stow the hammer.
comparisons.physical_skill: Dynamic tool swing with location, speed, and contact-duration control; no loose-body sorting or screen manipulation.
comparisons.success_condition: A ≥5° kick from a valid tap plus released hammer stable for 1 s; explicit strike-speed and placement thresholds.
comparisons.reason: Tests transient impact control and diagnostic response rather than sustained bimanual load handling.

comparisons.objective: Enclose a knife and fork by rolling them in a cloth napkin; not separate retained parts from media.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable-cloth edge acquisition, wrapping, regrasping, and containment of cutlery.
comparisons.success_condition: Specified napkin winding and coverage around aligned cutlery, released on the table; versions use different final dwell/scoring tiers.
comparisons.reason: Although both manage multiple loose items, this tests deformable wrapping and joint containment, the opposite of aperture-based separation.

comparisons.objective: Press three culture-tube caps to an intermediate vented detent.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated axial alignment and depth/force control to stop at the first snap position.
comparisons.success_condition: All caps centered, upright, and 4–6 mm depressed, still for 1 s; over-seating fails that tube.
comparisons.reason: Tests precision partial seating at a detent, not bimanual screen agitation or selective retention.

comparisons.objective: Meter 10 mL of syrup into a held dosing cup and replace both vessels.
comparisons.physical_skill: Level vessel holding, controlled pouring, flow cutoff, and spill avoidance—not dry-particle sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: 9–11 mL dose, ≤0.5 mL spill, cup and bottle placed and released for 1 s; explicit overdose/spill failures.
comparisons.reason: Tests liquid metering and pour control; shared tilt and receiver concepts do not establish overlap.

comparisons.objective: Collect an anterior nasal specimen with prescribed circles in both nostrils and recap the swab.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine force-controlled tool circling in a confined compliant opening, depth control, and recapping.
comparisons.success_condition: Four valid circles per nostril at 0.3–2 N and specified depth, capped and released for 1 s; contamination and over-depth failures are explicit.
comparisons.reason: Tests delicate contact tracing and contamination avoidance, not many-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Unfold and form a gable carton's pouring spout, ending before any pouring.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual manipulation of connected creased facets and stabilization of a folding package.
comparisons.success_condition: Mouth ≥30 mm, tip and lip project ≥8 mm, carton supported and released for 3 s; broken creases invalidate.
comparisons.reason: Tests crease-mediated shape formation. Its three-second released dwell resembles the candidate only generically.

comparisons.objective: Cut a copper tube through using a screw-feed tubing cutter without denting it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Alternating cutter rotation, incremental feed adjustment, and offcut handling.
comparisons.success_condition: Cut through all around, offcut removed and released for 1 s; excessive feed or >0.3 mm out-of-round latches zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests progressive cutting and feed-force discipline, not selective screening of loose materials.

comparisons.objective: Inspect a suitcase pull handle at four lock heights and tag defective units.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bracing, telescoping-handle actuation, load testing, state-dependent tagging, and closure.
comparisons.success_condition: All heights checked or worn lock made to give, correct tag verdict, handle closed, case restored, arms returned for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests active mechanical inspection and conditional disposition, not separation by aperture size.

comparisons.objective: Return a tilted window sash to its frame and engage both latches.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load balancing about pivots while simultaneously retracting two spring latches.
comparisons.success_condition: Sash upright with both bolts in slots and stable for 1 s; pivot loss invalidates. No explicit hand-clearance requirement is stated.
comparisons.reason: Bimanual load sharing is shared, but this tests coordinated hinge motion and simultaneous latch control rather than selective loose-body sifting.

comparisons.objective: Route a flexible lamp cable into a holder while keeping it clear of a hot plate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing and whole-body keep-out management.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug seated and released, cable on table ≥5 cm from hot plate for 1 s; any passage over the plate latches zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests flexible-object routing around a hazard, not rigid many-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Hold a nail upright while another arm hammers it into a post.
comparisons.physical_skill: Coordinated stabilization, impact timing, and withdrawal from a hammer path.
comparisons.success_condition: Score is insertion depth over 4 cm; arm-arm or hammer-helper contact zeros the run. Release, final stability, and dwell thresholds are not fully specified.
comparisons.reason: Tests cooperative holding under impact. Missing rubric details do not create plausible overlap with selective sifting.

comparisons.objective: Configure a meter test switch safely and insert a test plug.
comparisons.physical_skill: Ordered blade-switch actuation, constrained plug insertion, and electrical interlock reasoning.
comparisons.success_condition: Required switches open, forbidden phases unmoved, plug seated and mechanically verified after release; unsafe CT-open state zeros the run.
comparisons.reason: Tests safety-critical switch sequencing and insertion, not physical material separation.

comparisons.objective: Unfold, orient, and hang elastic folding headphones.
comparisons.physical_skill: Articulated-object unfolding, passive-joint alignment, springy-band handling, and hanging.
comparisons.success_condition: Fold joints opened, earcups oriented, headset released and stably hanging for 5 s. Damage thresholds are not detailed.
comparisons.reason: Tests articulated-object configuration and hanging; generic bimanual orientation and release do not overlap with sifting.

comparisons.objective: Calibrate a mounted tool tip by touching one reference point from four distinct orientations.
comparisons.physical_skill: Submillimeter point maintenance while changing tool-axis direction and controlling light contact.
comparisons.success_condition: Four one-second contacts, each 10–35° from vertical and ≥15° from prior axes; tool mount must remain fixed.
comparisons.reason: Tests precision multi-pose contact calibration, not manipulation of loose materials.

comparisons.objective: Seat a bracket bolt using a ratchet within confined access.
comparisons.physical_skill: Socket engagement and repeated short ratchet strokes under spatial constraints.
comparisons.success_condition: Actual bolt-head/bracket contact with thread integrity, continuously held 0.5 s. Torque and cycle count are diagnostic only; explicit tool-release criteria are absent.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded fastening and confined tool use, not selective aperture passage.

comparisons.objective: Assemble and mesh three gears on assigned shafts.
comparisons.physical_skill: Peg/shaft insertion, contact-guided tooth-phase alignment, and sequential rigid-part placement.
comparisons.success_condition: All gears seated, meshed, still, and both arms clear for 1 s, with partial credit for seated gears/pairs.
comparisons.reason: Tests phase-sensitive assembly of individual parts, not simultaneous size-selective separation.

comparisons.objective: Feed flexible filament at least 2 cm into a 3D-printer feeder.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual straightening and insertion of a slender springy filament into a narrow funnel and bore.
comparisons.success_condition: End ≥2 cm deep, on axis, released and still for 1 s; kinking, spool loss, or falling zeros the trial.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable linear insertion and kink prevention, not rigid-body sifting.

comparisons.objective: Connect an M12 sensor cable while preventing the loose sensor from rotating.
comparisons.physical_skill: Cap removal, connector alignment, bimanual stabilization, and coupling-ring tightening.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap in tray, connector engaged and tightened one turn, hands released and arms returned for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded connector mating under reaction torque, not loose-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Align and press a servo horn onto the zero-index spline.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine angular indexing, bore/shaft alignment, and axial press-fitting.
comparisons.success_condition: Horn seated flush at the correct tooth, still, and grippers clear for 1 s. Spec versions differ on whether an earlier wrong seating permanently zeros the run.
comparisons.reason: Tests indexed spline insertion; shared alignment and release primitives are insufficient for overlap.

comparisons.objective: Mount an ASTM dogbone specimen in two spring-closed tensile-test grips at the specified gauge length.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hold-open insertion into opposed wedge grips, crosshead jogging, and straight specimen alignment.
comparisons.success_condition: Both tabs seated with end gaps, levers closed, 115±5 mm jaw spacing, specimen within 2°, grippers clear for 3 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests bilateral clamping and metrology setup, not selective separation through openings.

comparisons.objective: Clear a hot soldering iron into its holder before placing a circuit board on the mat.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard-aware tool handling, cord management, cage insertion, and board placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Iron safely caged, board placed, grippers clear, stable for 1 s; hazardous contacts or displacement latch zero. An older version allowed partial board-only credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests hazard remediation and ordered workspace preparation, not sifting.

comparisons.objective: Install two brake pads in retainers and close the caliper over them.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tight-clearance pad insertion, orientation discrimination, flush seating, and articulated caliper closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Both pads fully seated on correct sides, caliper within 1°, hands 5 cm clear for 2 s; dropped pad caps score.
comparisons.reason: Tests multi-part automotive assembly and closure, not selective recovery/retention by aperture size.

comparisons.objective: Clamp a round-bottom flask by its neck in a spring-closed lab clamp.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual lever holding, fragile-object placement, controlled jaw closure, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Flask upright and suspended in closed jaws, never dropped or tipped, arms returned, stable for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests fragile-object clamping against a spring, not screen manipulation or particle separation.

comparisons.objective: Calibrate two wrist cameras by acquiring diverse ChArUco-board views and return both arms.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-view arm positioning, visibility/occlusion management, and precise stationary sampling; no task-object transport.
comparisons.success_condition: Each camera obtains ≥12 diverse valid samples and meets calibration error limits; board unmoved, arms home for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests perception-calibration trajectory coverage, not dexterous material handling.

comparisons.objective: Fit a long kerf-in weatherstrip into a door jamb with both ends flush.
comparisons.physical_skill: Long deformable-strip alignment and progressive barbed-fin insertion without bunching or stretch.
comparisons.success_condition: Entire fin ≥8 mm into kerf, both ends within 2 mm, hands clear and strip still for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests distributed deformable insertion along a slot, not rigid many-body selection through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Transfer four fragile cookies from a sheet pan to a cooling rack using a turner.
comparisons.physical_skill: Thin-blade acquisition, level carrying, repeated placement, and breakage/touch avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: Four intact untouched cookies flat on rack, tool restored, pan unmoved, hands clear and all stable for 1 s; drops and spoilage reduce or zero score.
comparisons.reason: Tests serial fragile-item transfer with a utensil, not simultaneous media/workpiece separation.

comparisons.objective: Seat and latch a switch line card using paired ejector levers.
comparisons.physical_skill: Coordinated lever closure, connector-force control, and avoidance of card cocking.
comparisons.success_condition: Both card ends within 1 mm of home, both levers within 3°, hands clear, held 1 s; excessive end-gap mismatch invalidates.
comparisons.reason: Tests synchronized leverage and connector seating, not selective many-body separation through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Move six crackers to a basket while excluding a desiccant packet.
comparisons.physical_skill: Object classification and repeated individual pick-and-place, including partially occluded crackers.
comparisons.success_condition: Per-cracker credit after supported release and 1 s stillness; packet entering or touching the basket permanently zeros the run.
comparisons.reason: Both require retaining an unwanted item, but this tests semantic selection and individual transfer rather than geometry-based sifting of mixed loose bodies.

comparisons.objective: Use a scoop to serve clean ice while avoiding contaminated fish-bin ice.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lid removal, source selection, scoop loading and pouring, with contact-history hygiene control.
comparisons.success_condition: Full credit for a clean-source cube delivered by the scoop after opening the lid, with no contamination or fish-source delivery, sustained 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests source/hygiene selection and scoop use, not simultaneous size-selective passage and retention in a lifted screen.

comparisons.objective: Use a scoop to put clean ice into a bowl.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lid removal, clean-source selection, scoop pickup and controlled delivery.
comparisons.success_condition: One clean cube delivered by the scoop after lid opening, without contamination or fish-bin ice, sustained 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Despite shared loose-body handling, the tested ability is hygienic source selection with a scoop, not physical sieve separation.

comparisons.objective: Release two simultaneous latches, remove a lid, and set it down.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual inward latch actuation followed by coordinated lifting and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Lid flat beside the case and still for 1 s; partial credit for one/both latch release and lift clearance; excessive case motion zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests simultaneous latch release and lid extraction, not load-sharing agitation or selective passage of mixed contents.

comparisons.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap, remove its battery, and sort the parts.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, threaded disassembly, tipping an internal cell, and careful placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap turned at least 300° and set down, battery in bin, flashlight outside bin, all released and still for 1 s; forced thread removal or loss zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded disassembly and extraction of one captive component, not sieve-mediated many-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Stand an oversized flat box on edge in a narrow slot.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual compression grasp, lifting to a riser, and pivoting a large load over an edge.
comparisons.success_condition: Box upright within 20° in the slot and still for 2 s; half credit for lying flat on the riser.
comparisons.reason: Tests large-object reorientation using environmental support, not selective loose-body sorting.

comparisons.objective: Insert a circuit board into an antistatic bag and place the bag in a crate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-and-insert alignment of thin parts, then released placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Board fully inside the narrow cavity, bag wholly resting in crate, released and still for 1 s; falling parts zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained planar insertion into a cavity, not aperture passage, agitation, or retention of a second object class.

comparisons.objective: Lever a press-fit paint-tin lid off with a screwdriver and set it safely down.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool pickup, blade insertion into a groove, progressive prying, tin reorientation, and lid handling.
comparisons.success_condition: Lid removed and placed flat, ultimately paint-side up in later versions, hands clear and still for 1 s; unsafe tilt, movement, loss, or missing blade insertion zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests tool-mediated progressive release of a press fit, not bimanual sifting.

comparisons.objective: Create safe gaps between three parcels on a continuously moving conveyor.
comparisons.physical_skill: Time-critical interception, temporary lifting, and repositioning on a moving surface.
comparisons.success_condition: All parcels pass with two measured gaps, full credit at ≥5 cm each; off-belt, stacked, overly long lifts, or invalid scanner passage zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests dynamic conveyor spacing rather than selective separation by physical aperture size.

comparisons.objective: Clear snapped filament from a 3D-printer extruder and discard it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hold a spring lever open while pulling a constrained slender rod, then release and dispose.
comparisons.success_condition: Filament fully removed and in tray, lever restored, arms returned, held still for 1 s; partial credit for extraction progress.
comparisons.reason: Tests coupled lever actuation and linear extraction, not many-body sifting or retentate preservation.

comparisons.objective: Clamp a glued panel joint closed with three alternating clamps.
comparisons.physical_skill: Clamp placement, controlled jaw force, joint alignment, and alternating above/below configuration.
comparisons.success_condition: Joint ≤0.2 mm open, boards level, three clamps snug at 1–6 N in the alternating pattern, hands clear and still for 1 s; over-force zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests distributed force application and panel alignment, not loose-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Lock spring tongs shut and store them in a tray compartment.
comparisons.physical_skill: Compressing a spring tool while operating its locking tab, followed by constrained placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Tongs locked, fully inside the long compartment, released and still for 2 s; partial credit separates locking from placement.
comparisons.reason: Tests articulated-tool locking and storage, not selective material screening.

comparisons.objective: Seat four studs on edge in a layout jig against an end fence.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated large-part reorientation, slot alignment, squaring, and insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Per-stud credit for upright slot seating, with full credit when all four ends are within 2 mm of the fence for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests repeated rigid-part jig loading, not agitation-driven separation of mixed small bodies.

comparisons.objective: Refit an insect screen into all four window channels and release it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual frame handling, spring-plunger compression, swing-in alignment, and controlled seating.
comparisons.success_condition: All edges seated, screen within 3°, plungers bearing, hands ≥2 cm clear and still for 1 s; drops or forced penetration zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests compliant frame insertion into channels, not filtering loose media through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Connect and route a door-lamp cord, then latch and cycle a junction-box door.
comparisons.physical_skill: Plug insertion, cord placement under a clip, latch operation, and routing across a moving hinge.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug seated, cord clipped, door latched and surviving an open-close inspection; trapped cord or premature closure can zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests cable routing and persistence across articulated-door motion, not selective bulk separation.

comparisons.objective: Zip an already-started jacket to the collar.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pin flexible fabric while pulling and potentially regrasping a zipper slider.
comparisons.success_condition: Progress equals remaining travel closed; full credit within 3 mm of top with both hands >40 mm clear, while pin protrusion >3 mm zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable stabilization and guided slider travel, not rigid-body sifting.

comparisons.objective: Remove exactly one tightly packed toilet roll by its core and stand it in a bin.
comparisons.physical_skill: Internal-core grasp, vertical extraction from a packed array, and gentle upright placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Exactly one roll in bin, upright and released for 2 s; disturbance, damage, extra removal, or dropping reduces or zeros credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests extraction of one chosen packed object via an internal grasp, not simultaneous size-based separation of mixed bodies.

comparisons.objective: Use a fry scoop to portion fries into a carton and restore the station.
comparisons.physical_skill: Scoop loading, bimanual carton stabilization, controlled pouring, and tool return.
comparisons.success_condition: 70–145 g served, carton upright, ≤4 spills, scoop returned, arms home, all still for 1 s; hand-contacted fries or carton immersion penalize.
comparisons.reason: Shares bulk transfer and spill control, but tests measured scooping into a held carton rather than selective aperture passage with retained workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Remove a seatbelt twist by passing a fold through its sliding tongue.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable fold formation, threading through a narrow slot, spreading, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Webbing intact and flat, tongue retained, width >40 mm, roll <15°, hands released for 3 s; damage or detachment zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable untwisting through retained hardware, not rigid granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Route and seat a strut across keep-outs without disturbing a sensitive housing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Obstacle-aware transport, handoff through a cradle, and tight saddle alignment.
comparisons.success_condition: Both strut ends seated within millimetric tolerances while housing remains within motion/tilt limits, held 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests collision-free handoff and precision seating of one long object, not selective screening.

comparisons.objective: Land a ferruled wire in the correct push-in terminal.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine target identification, axial insertion, spring-clamp engagement, and released pull retention.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct entry only, collar home, clamp engaged, and 50 N pull test with <1.5 mm withdrawal; wrong-entry penetration zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests fine wire insertion and retention in a selected terminal, not loose-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Measure a bar with a spring-return tape and enter its length.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hook seating, aligned tape extension, visual reading, and keypad entry.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct integer submitted after a valid measurement within 120 s; earlier versions provide staged measurement credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests metrology and physical data entry, not material handling or screening.

comparisons.objective: Load two forceps into a sterilizer basket in the required open state.
comparisons.physical_skill: Manipulate articulated ratcheted tools, preserve opening during transport, and arrange without stacking.
comparisons.success_condition: Both forceps flat, open ≥15°, wholly in basket, released and still for 1 s; graded partial outcomes are explicit.
comparisons.reason: Tests process-state configuration of articulated instruments plus placement, not size-selective separation.

comparisons.objective: Fit two bevelled steel coupons for a V-groove weld.
comparisons.physical_skill: Part flipping, bevel identification, planar alignment, and millimetric gap setting.
comparisons.success_condition: Both bevels face inward, 1.6–3.2 mm root gap at both ends, ends aligned within 5 mm, flat and still for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests two-part weld fit-up geometry, not agitation and multi-object sorting.

comparisons.objective: Move a heavy upright carton onto a low platform using the step edge as a pivot.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load control, leading-edge placement, pushing, and pivoting between levels.
comparisons.success_condition: Carton fully flat and released on platform for 1 s; staged credit for bridging/overhang; >20° tilt at any time zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests level change and pivoting of one heavy load, not selective separation of small bodies.

comparisons.objective: Assemble and tighten a copper-pipe compression fitting.
comparisons.physical_skill: Ordered component assembly, pipe insertion, nut threading, and torque-limited spanner use.
comparisons.success_condition: Pipe home, olive correctly under nut, nut 3/4–1 1/4 turns past snug, tool returned, hands clear and still; over-tightening zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded fitting assembly and controlled tightening, not sieve manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Remove a named cartridge fuse with an insulated puller and place it in a tray.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool grasp, correct-fuse selection, constrained jaw placement, and rocking extraction from spring clips.
comparisons.success_condition: F2 removed while held by puller and placed at rest in tray; disturbing F1/F3 zeros, and unsupported removal caps credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests tool-mediated selective extraction from clips, not passive geometry-based separation of a mixed free-body load.

comparisons.objective: Instill exactly one eye drop into a drawn-down lower-lid pocket and return the bottle.
comparisons.physical_skill: Light-force lid manipulation, precise bottle aiming, squeeze metering, and contamination-free clearance.
comparisons.success_condition: Exactly one drop in the pocket, no tip/eye contact or excessive force, bottle released on tray, lid restored, held 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests delicate dosing and soft-contact control, not rigid-body screening.

comparisons.objective: Use a plumb bob to transfer and mark a point on a worktop.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pendulum damping, contact-free observation, and precise pencil marking in restricted clearance.
comparisons.success_condition: Bob free and within 3 mm of plumb for 1.5 s; all marks made during that state within 3 mm, pencil lifted, final state held 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests oscillation damping and measurement transfer, not loose-object separation.

comparisons.objective: Secure a T-shirt to a clothesline with two pegs.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable cloth handling and simultaneous spring-clamp capture of fabric and line.
comparisons.success_condition: Two valid pegs ≥100 mm apart support the shirt ≥20 mm above the table for 5 s; damage or external support zeros.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable fastening with clamps, not rigid many-body sifting.

comparisons.objective: Empty sink-strainer scraps into a caddy and reseat the strainer.
comparisons.physical_skill: Small-knob pickup, transport and tipping of a loose-body container, then tight bore reseating.
comparisons.success_condition: All nine scraps in caddy, basket reseated within 4 mm/8°, hands clear, still 1 s; drain loss, counter spill, basket loss, or dropping permanently zeros.
comparisons.reason: This is the closest manipulation overlap because it transfers multiple loose bodies by tipping and reseats their container, but it does not test selective passage through apertures while retaining a second object class; all scraps are transferred together.

comparisons.objective: Reassemble a fan: keyed blade insertion, threaded spinner tightening, and grille clipping; not material separation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequential alignment, insertion, counterholding, rotation, and clip actuation versus bimanual sieve agitation and size-selective retention.
comparisons.success_condition: Blade keyed, spinner tight, grille clipped, hands clear, 1 s stillness; no recovery fraction or passage-through-aperture requirement.
comparisons.reason: Tests multi-stage appliance assembly, not selective many-body separation.

comparisons.objective: Peel the correct day label and adhere it flat to a food-tub lid; not separate mixed rigid parts.
comparisons.physical_skill: Thin-sheet peeling, placement, and progressive adhesion versus load-shared screen lifting and agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct label wholly placed, four quarters adhered, released for 1 s; wrong-label and tub-disturbance failures.
comparisons.reason: Tests adhesive-sheet handling rather than physical sieving.

comparisons.objective: Carry an intact three-box stack onto a shelf in one trip; not partition mixed objects by size.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual whole-stack compression and transport versus controlled agitation that intentionally moves media relative to the held screen.
comparisons.success_condition: Stack never separates or exceeds slide/tilt limits and ends standing on the shelf.
comparisons.reason: Although both share bimanual load support, the tested abilities and required internal motion are opposite.

comparisons.objective: Open a crown-capped bottle with a mounted opener and place it on a coaster.
comparisons.physical_skill: Align cap to opener, lever the bottle, preserve uprightness, and place it versus screen tilting/agitation and particle retention.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap removed by opener, bottle upright on coaster, released and still for 1 s; excessive tilt or falling gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained tool engagement and cap removal, not sorting through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Identify red reject cartons on a moving line and push them onto a reject table while leaving brown cartons in flow.
comparisons.physical_skill: Timed conveyor interception and lateral pushing versus bimanual screen manipulation and geometry-based many-body separation.
comparisons.success_condition: Each reject rests on the reject table with monitored legal trajectory; normal cartons must remain on line.
comparisons.reason: Both are separation tasks only at a generic classification level; this record tests moving-line selective rejection, not sieve passage and retained workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Set and latch a sprung rat trap without triggering it or entering the strike path.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual spring restraint, bar placement, and safety-zone avoidance versus load sharing and controlled sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Hammer latched back, grippers clear, arms returned; snap or unsafe unrestrained strike-path entry gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests hazardous spring-mechanism control, not particle separation.

comparisons.objective: Remove and discard a worn toothbrush head, open a pack, and install a new head.
comparisons.physical_skill: Clamshell opening and axial pull/push-fit exchange versus screen lifting, agitation, and selective retention.
comparisons.success_condition: New head fully seated, old head in bin, arms returned, held 1 s; partial stages separately scored.
comparisons.reason: Tests component replacement and axial insertion.

comparisons.objective: Mount a phone in a sprung car holder and release it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Open or oppose sprung arms, center and seat a phone, then establish edge clamping versus bimanual screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Holder arms clamp phone edges, phone is seated/still, hands clear for 1 s; drops fail.
comparisons.reason: Tests spring-clamp insertion and seating, not many-body filtration.

comparisons.objective: Cut a padlock shackle from a cage gate with bolt cutters.
comparisons.physical_skill: Position cutting jaws, stabilize the lock, and close long handles versus gentle orientation-controlled sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Shackle cut without dragging the lock, cutter returned and released, hands clear for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests destructive cutting and force amplification.

comparisons.objective: Tighten a locknut in restricted swing space by repeatedly re-engaging an open-end wrench.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool indexing, flipping, jaw re-engagement, and torque application versus screen load sharing and agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Credit follows net nut rotation up to at least 178 degrees seated and held 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Tests constrained wrench manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Seat a telescoping lid squarely over a product without wedging or moving the base.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual planar alignment and controlled enclosure insertion versus deliberate loose-body motion through apertures.
comparisons.success_condition: Lid seated, centered, square, box still, hands off for 1 s; falls and invalid product states fail.
comparisons.reason: Tests tight-clearance lid mating, not separation.

comparisons.objective: Open a folded wheelchair fully and leave it standing in its original area.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual expansion and seating of linked frame rails versus lifting and agitating a loaded screen.
comparisons.success_condition: Both seat rails seated, chair remains within position/heading limits, hands clear; tipping is permanent zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests deployment of a large articulated mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Handle an expired analyzer kit correctly by removing it to the grey tray and calling a supervisor.
comparisons.physical_skill: State-based decision, kit placement, and button actuation versus physical size-selective separation.
comparisons.success_condition: Full credit requires kit in tray and supervisor called; any insertion into analyzer gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests procedural reject handling, not dexterous sieve mechanics.

comparisons.objective: Stop a spinning centrifuge safely, open it, and transfer a sample tube to a rack.
comparisons.physical_skill: Interlock-aware waiting/actuation, lid opening, and tube extraction versus screen agitation and retention.
comparisons.success_condition: Rotor stopped before lid opening, tube upright in rack; premature opening, apparatus movement, or tube loss fails.
comparisons.reason: Tests safe interaction with rotating equipment.

comparisons.objective: Hold a seedling upright while pouring soil clods around it, then leave it standing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus bulk pouring and burial versus bimanual screen agitation that passes small media while retaining larger rings.
comparisons.success_condition: Seedling centered/upright/on hole floor, at least 32 of 45 clods in hole, released and still 2 s.
comparisons.reason: Both manipulate multiple loose bodies, but this tests filling around a retained plant rather than aperture-based selective separation.

comparisons.objective: Transfer a sterile cord off-field and connect it to a console without contaminating the field.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff, flexible-cord routing, insertion, and sterile-zone discipline versus rigid-body sieving.
comparisons.success_condition: Cord in holder slot and connector inserted; numerous contact-based contamination events permanently give zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests contamination-aware deformable routing and connector insertion.

comparisons.objective: Bend copper tubing to 90 degrees while compensating for springback and releasing the lever.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lever-bender loading, force application, overbend judgment, and relaxation versus controlled screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Relaxed tube angle 87–93 degrees, lever returned, hands clear and still 1 s; overbend beyond 96 degrees fails.
comparisons.reason: Tests plastic forming with springback.

comparisons.objective: Identify an n-type (100) wafer by flats and mount it correctly on a tape-mounter chuck.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine tweezer edge handling, visual discrimination, precision orientation, and vacuum actuation versus bulk sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct wafer pattern-side down, centered and flat-aligned, vacuum on, tools clear; forbidden surface contact or drops fail.
comparisons.reason: Tests fragile precision part identification and mounting.

comparisons.objective: Pick four arriving parts from two conveyor lanes into a bin before deadlines.
comparisons.physical_skill: Timed multi-object interception and direct carrier-to-bin transfer versus lifting and agitating one screen to filter a mixture.
comparisons.success_condition: Each cube in bin earns 0.25; staging, missing the deadline, or knocking a cube off loses that cube.
comparisons.reason: Generic multi-object transfer is shared, but the tested ability is conveyor scheduling rather than geometry-selective passage.

comparisons.objective: Straighten a sprung training doll’s legs while positioning a footboard to measure body length.
comparisons.physical_skill: Simultaneous compliant limb restraint and sliding gauge placement versus loose-body sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: Valid bilateral contact geometry held 0.5 s, footboard reading preserved, doll not lifted or displaced.
comparisons.reason: Tests anthropometric positioning under spring forces.

comparisons.objective: Mount, rotate, and engage a Sankey D keg coupler.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bayonet alignment, constrained rotation, and over-center handle actuation versus screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Coupler caught and turned at least 85 degrees, handle locked, probe engaged, hands released; premature handle use or keg/line disturbance fails.
comparisons.reason: Tests multi-stage fluid-coupler installation.

comparisons.objective: Clean an SC fiber ferrule with a prescribed tape stroke, then insert and latch it into an adapter.
comparisons.physical_skill: Contact-controlled cleaning stroke followed by precision connector insertion and latching versus bulk material separation.
comparisons.success_condition: Valid ≥21 mm one-way clean precedes insertion; ferrule must remain uncontaminated and connector latched/released.
comparisons.reason: Tests surface preparation and precision optical connection.

comparisons.objective: Hang two fragile glass baubles on stand branches.
comparisons.physical_skill: Small-hook threading and low-impact placement versus tab grasping and many-body agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Both branch-through-hook relationships present, released and slow for 2 s; breakage proxy permanently gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests delicate hook placement.

comparisons.objective: Swap two loaded cash-drawer inserts, close the drawer, and avoid spilling coins.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual tray lifting, level transport, seating, and drawer closure versus screen tilting intended to move selected contents.
comparisons.success_condition: Old insert on mat, counted insert seated with orientation preserved, drawer latched, arms home; excessive tilt/drop gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Both preserve loose contents, but this record forbids relative-content motion and tests tray exchange rather than selective sifting.

comparisons.objective: Remove and discard an old vacuum bag, seat a new bag collar, and close the vacuum.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bag extraction, thin collar alignment into channels, seating, and lid latching versus rigid screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Old bag in wastebasket, new collar started then fully seated, lid shut/latched, hands clear for 1 s; drops and vacuum displacement cap credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests consumable replacement and channel insertion.

comparisons.objective: Rethread a hoodie drawstring through its fabric casing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deformable cord advancement with a threader and preservation of the trailing end versus rigid many-body filtration.
comparisons.success_condition: Cord follows casing with ≥8 cm at each opening, intact and released 3 s; lost trailing end or damage overrides credit.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable routing through a hidden channel.

comparisons.objective: Clamp a bar in a lathe chuck at specified stick-out and position the cutting tool without contact.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bar alignment, chuck-key tightening, and precision tool positioning versus bimanual sifting.
comparisons.success_condition: All jaws clamp the aligned bar with 55–65 mm stick-out; tool lies within specified axial/radial gaps and never touches.
comparisons.reason: Tests machine-tool setup and clearance control.

comparisons.objective: Remove a staple while preserving two paper sheets.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine prying and extraction with damage-limited force versus loaded screen lifting and agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Both staple legs clear, intact staple ≥10 mm away, released 3 s; tears, punctures, or staple breakage give zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests nondestructive fastener extraction.

comparisons.objective: Secure a clevis pin by bending the two cotter-pin legs in opposite directions.
comparisons.physical_skill: Small-part plastic bending and fixture stabilization versus screen orientation and particle flow.
comparisons.success_condition: Both legs bent at least 60 degrees, fingers ≥2 cm clear and still for 1 s; significant rebending gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests permanent fastener forming.

comparisons.objective: Scoop exactly one meatball onto a plate without utensil cross-contamination.
comparisons.physical_skill: Utensil-supported acquisition, transport, release, and contamination-aware contact management versus aperture-mediated filtering.
comparisons.success_condition: Exactly one actual scoop-and-delivery; full credit requires clean utensil and no contamination, with released stable placement.
comparisons.reason: Both involve selecting from multiple bodies, but this tests single-item serving and hygiene, not bulk size separation.

comparisons.objective: Trace tangled cables to match two box ends and place only the corresponding plugs into holders.
comparisons.physical_skill: Cable identity tracing and plug placement without disturbing distractor cords versus sieve manipulation.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct plugs in matching holders; moving distractor plugs, cross-placement, or pulling a cable from its box gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests correspondence tracing through flexible cables.

comparisons.objective: Find and fully reseat the one half-inserted network plug without disturbing seated plugs.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fault identification and guarded axial insertion in a crowded connector bank versus screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: Loose plug reaches ≥22 mm depth and hands release; any originally seated plug becoming shallow gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests connector diagnosis and reseating.

comparisons.objective: Select the diameter-matching pin and seat it fully in a fixture hole.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fit discrimination, precision alignment, and insertion versus separating many bodies by passage through many apertures.
comparisons.success_condition: Only the 20 mm pin counts; it must be ≥22 mm inserted, near vertical, and still 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Although aperture fit appears in both, this is single-part selection and insertion, not dynamic filtration with retained parts.

comparisons.objective: Use two sticks as improvised tongs to lift a cup from a fire pit onto a stone.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual indirect grasp formation, cooperative lifting, and upright placement versus directly grasping screen tabs and agitating contents.
comparisons.success_condition: Cup upright and centered on flat stone, still 2 s; partial credit only for removal from pit.
comparisons.reason: Tests tool-mediated cooperative transport.

comparisons.objective: Invert a cake pan and plate together, set them down, and lift the pan away to release the cake.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual clamping, coordinated 180-degree inversion, compliant release, and un-molding versus repeated sifting motions.
comparisons.success_condition: Cake upside down and centered on plate/stand, pan removed, all still 2 s; damage/drop conditions apply in full rubric.
comparisons.reason: Both manage contents during orientation change, but this tests whole-item inversion and mold release, not size-selective many-body passage.

comparisons.objective: Hold a loaf safely and saw off a slice of specified thickness.
comparisons.physical_skill: Claw-grip stabilization, knife sawing, thickness control, and blade clearance versus screen agitation.
comparisons.success_condition: A 1–2 cm slice fully separated while both grippers remain ≥3 cm from blade; unsafe proximity gives zero.
comparisons.reason: Tests guarded cutting.

comparisons.objective: Align a loose pipe end and slide a repair coupling across the pipe joint.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual pipe support, coaxial alignment, and sleeve translation versus sieve load sharing and selective flow.
comparisons.success_condition: Each pipe inserted ≥30 mm into centered coupling, new pipe aligned and seated in elbow, hands released; pullout or falling permanently fails.
comparisons.reason: Tests long-part alignment and coupling installation, not particle separation.
